The stress tensor incorporates both normal (pressure) and shear (parallel) forces acting on a cross-sectional area, allowing for the calculation of stress (force per unit area) in different directions within the object. Thus, the **stress tensor** is the mathematical tool used to relate forces to the cross-sectional area in the context of calculating stress within a volume.
